title: Motor insurance renewal: customer mentions a second car and a new driver; agent misses both

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Good morning, this is Rahul from Kosha General Insurance. This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Am I speaking with Mister Mehta?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, speaking.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am calling about the renewal of your car insurance policy, which expires on the fifteenth.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Right, I wanted to renew it. Actually my wife also bought a second car last month, a small hatchback.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay. So for your policy, the renewal premium is eleven thousand four hundred rupees.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Fine. Can I pay online?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, I will send you a payment link by message.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Also my son just got his driving licence and he will use the car sometimes.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Noted. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No, that is all. Thank you.

title: Business-loan sales call: recording disclosure skipped, approval guaranteed, rate quoted before credit-assessment disclosure

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hi, this is Vikram from Kosha Capital. I saw that you applied for a business loan on our website.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, I need about twenty lakh rupees for my shop.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Great. Do not worry, the approval is guaranteed for you, and the interest rate will be only twelve percent.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Really? It is guaranteed?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, one hundred percent. You will definitely get the loan.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay. What documents do you need from me?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Just your PAN card, Aadhaar, and twelve months of bank statements.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: And what is the processing fee?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It is very small, I will tell you later.

title: Overdue EMI call: customer frustration rises and payment difficulty is disclosed

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello, this is Neha from Kosha Capital. This call is recorded. I am calling about your monthly installment that was due on the fifth.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I already told your colleague yesterday, I will pay next week.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand. But the installment is overdue, and late charges are applying.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: This is ridiculous. How many times do I have to explain the same thing?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Sir, as per our policy, I need to remind you.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I lost my job last month and I simply cannot pay right now. You people keep calling me again and again.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Can you pay at least half of the amount today?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Are you even listening to me? This is so frustrating.

title: Noisy, ambiguous call on a bad line: should produce no low-value nudges

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello, this is Kosha Capital. This call is recorded for quality.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hello? Sorry, the line is very bad.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Can you hear me now?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Uh, yeah, hmm. I am on the road, the signal is weak.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Is this about your loan application?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Maybe, I do not know. My brother handles it.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: No problem at all.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hmm, okay. Sorry, hello?

title: HELD-OUT (written after rule tuning): noisy market background, routine document follow-up; no nudge needed

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Good afternoon, this is Priya from Kosha Capital. This call is being recorded.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi, sorry, I am at the market, it is very noisy here.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: No worries. I am calling about the documents for your loan application.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Which documents? I think I sent everything already.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We still need the bank statement for March.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, okay. I will check and upload it tonight.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you, that would be great.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes. Bye.
